# Mabel Colby

[Regent’s Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy)

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P19](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0019), [v3 ch.Relationships P40](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking woman with dark eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed young woman with an imaginative nature and a heart full of yearning dreams. She harbours a deep dread of being forced back into the harsh environment of boardinghouses if [Tabby](../character/tabby.md) and [Maria](../character/maria.md) return to disrupt her current small haven.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)_

## Traits

- imaginative and dream-filled  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- returning to boardinghouses if Tabby and Maria returned (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) with [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and worked continuously as a schoolteacher after graduating, including a stint in an isolated rural school. Facing limited financial means, Mabel sent a letter to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and Mabel lease a house together for the upcoming school year. The women successfully moved into Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris) alongside other housemates to share living expenses. While living together, Mabel complained about rising prices during an evening study session. During her final year at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), Mabel combated study fatigue on a rainy night by reviewing old [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) tales with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Friend P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), +11 more_

## Quotes

> "Cressy, you make no sense to me. It is obvious you are intentionally encouraging him, yet you are fully aware that your intentions are not serious."
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Charming P22](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0022)

> "My fear was that they would return, which would shatter our delightful small haven here, casting us unfortunate, inexperienced young ones back into the harsh realm of boardinghouses."
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "Oh, Nell, my intellect concurs with what you say. Nevertheless, my spirit continues to be gloomy and lacking in creative spark. Rainy evenings perpetually leave me feeling filthy and unkempt."
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "Nothing appears to have any value. Even my thoughts are ancient. I’ve already pondered every single one. What purpose does life serve anyway, Nell?"
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Cressida Lindsay! I never considered you completely heartless. To think you declared that you would delight in breaking a man’s heart!"
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Charming P20](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mabel-colby--nell-harcourt.md)

Mabel and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends and driven scholars who initially bonded as classmates at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Mabel takes the initiative in their living arrangements by writing a letter to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to propose that they and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. They end up sharing Tabby's Place, where Mabel joins [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and their housemates in evening studies and domestic life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +16 more_

- Friend of — close friends and driven scholars  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +3 more</sub>

### [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-euphemia--mabel-colby.md)

[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) is Mabel's aunt who resides with Mabel and her student friends at Tabby's Place. She provides a comfortable domestic presence for Mabel and the other girls without enforcing strict supervision over them. Mabel shares household routines with her, though she occasionally complains about practical matters like rising prices while gathered together in the evenings.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), +12 more_

- Relative of — aunt (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023)</sub>

### [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--mabel-colby.md)

Mabel and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) are school friends from their time at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Mabel arranges to live with [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by writing to propose leasing a house together for the school year. They go on to set up their household at Tabby's Place, where they study, cook, and prepare for examinations alongside one another.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +12 more_
